Package org.cyborgcats.component

Class MotorComponent

java.lang.Object
org.cyborgcats.component.MotorComponent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Component
Direct Known Subclasses:
PositionComponent, VelocityComponent
public class MotorComponent extends Object implements Component
Base component for any mechanism driven by a motor, providing setpoint application and input logging for a leader motor and any number of followers.

Followers are driven by applying the same control request as the leader rather than by a vendor follower request.
